description: Edge-case wiki for link reliability. Probes hazards a flat-slug wiki invites: duplicate basenames (slug collision) making [[bare]] links ambiguous; [[slug#heading]] / [[slug|Display]] link syntax that must still resolve; self-links; and cycles (must not loop or crash). run_wiki_edges asserts ONLY the categories listed here (it is edge-focused, unlike run_wiki which requires a clean corpus).
